decisions.decision: John Henshaw is to revise the debt policy.
Delete the 3% of Omnibus total provision from the debt policy (recommended).

decisions.decision: Recommended that the total debt, regular and exempt, not exceed 14% of the levy in the debt policy; FY17 represents the ceiling on exempt debt.
decisions.quote: it was recommended, for the debt policy that the total debt, regular and exempt, not exceed 14% of the levy.

decisions.decision: Recommended using $300K as the estimate for new growth.

decisions.decision: Recommended re-purposing the TC Passio school for town offices, selling the other 4 surplus buildings, and using sale proceeds to fund renovation of the TC Passio.

budget_items.topic: Debt as percent of property tax levy
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Regular and exempt debt as a percent of the tax levy is topping out this cycle at 13.7%.
budget_items.quote: topping out in this particular cycle, this year, at 13.7%.

budget_items.topic: Debt policy limits on regular and exempt debt
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Recommended caps: regular debt not to exceed 4% of the levy, exempt debt not to exceed 11% of the total levy, total debt not to exceed 14%.
budget_items.quote: it was recommend the regular debt not exceed 4% of the levy and exempt debt not to exceed 11% of the total levy.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The January bond issue included amounts for the pavement management plan, the track & field project, and the final town share of the latest sewer project.
budget_items.quote: 1.7m for the pavement management plan, 770k for the track & field project, 145k for the final portion of the towns cost for the latest sewer project.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The 1.7M issue covered $800k already spent by DPW; about $900K in new money remains, plus Chapter 90 and budget money, with the final borrowing probably in January.
budget_items.quote: the 1.7m issue covered the 800k the dpw spent during the last paving period. leaving about 900k in new money

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Recommended using 300K as the estimate for new growth.
budget_items.quote: it was recommend that 300k be used as the estimate for new growth.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Review of Omnibus totals showed it is almost impossible to hit the 3% of Omnibus total before reaching the 4% regular debt limit, so that provision was recommended for deletion.
budget_items.quote: review of the omnibus total numbers shows that is almost impossible to hit the 3% of the omnibus
